_doc: Real-world pace reference for Spa-Francorchamps, 2026 cars. Used as Phase 2 lap-time / top-speed sanity targets. Values only: no driver or team names (project IP rules).
source: 2026 Belgian Grand Prix qualifying, Formula 1 live-timing data via FastF1 3.9 (signed-in F1 TV account), retrieved 2026-11-01. Personal validation use only.

dryQualiLapS.note: plausible range = the 2026 qualifying field at Spa: from just under pole (1:44.361) to the slowest Q1 time (1:50.177). A scripted (non-optimal) driver should land inside it; the car model's ideal speed-profile lap must be faster than pole.

kemmelTopSpeedKmh.note: real 2026 pole lap: 312 km/h at the end of Kemmel (superclipping), 336 km/h maximum on the lap (FastF1 car data)

idealProfileLapS.note: quasi-steady-state lap of the car model on its racing line must be at least pole pace (car capable of the real lap)
